northSeaRestorationBinding.trap: entries_covering() in scripts/research/emit_cao_material_corrections.py skips restoration- palette entries, so a palaeo chart cut onto partitions 303 or 315 would take native Cao motion and detach from the restored North Sea shelf unless it is bound to the restoration entry explicitly

rotationTrap.consequence: loading only 1000_0_rotfile.rot leaves the sub-block sequences undefined; pyGPlates returns identity and the cookie-cut piece stays at its present-day position while its parent plate moves

schedule.lifecycleRule: (TOAGE, FROMAGE]: youngest bound exclusive, oldest bound inclusive

areaPreservationPercent.attribution: the raw excess is ground claimed twice where two present-day static partitions overlap; the compiler must give each cut piece exactly one owner, and the net figure is what that yields
